'''Charlie Company''' was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of nine [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] contracted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to support their [[Mission to Goratak III|mission]] to retrieve an [[I2-CG droid/Legends|I2-CG]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Goratak III]].
